item.name: Start an optimization run for a model

request.name: Start an optimization run for a model

description.content: This starts a one-off optimization run to solve the model given as an input.

item.name: Start an optimization run to evaluate the given model

request.name: Start an optimization run to evaluate the given model

description.content: Evaluation will not change the data that is being optimized. Instead it will evaluate the current allocation in comparison to the results the optimizer would produce.

item.name: Start an optimization run for the provided plan

request.name: Start an optimization run for the provided plan

description.content: This endpoint will start a one-off optimization run based on the provided plan. The plan can be generated using the GET /schedule/plan endpoint.
